prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1489
Claimant:
Destiny Smith
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
January 29, 2025
First notice of loss came in from the claimant, who reports being hit while turning left at an intersection and says they
were taken to hospital with a concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer, and I have logged the account
as given.
February 8, 2025
Spoke with the claimant by phone to go over the sequence of events. The desrciption of the collision matches what
they first reported, and they were clear about where each vehicle was when contact happened.
March 9, 2025
Reviewed the ploice report, which confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision and that the
other driver was turning across their path.
March 11, 2025
Took a recorded statement from the other driver. Their version of the turn and the point of impact lines up with the
claimant's account.
April 2, 2025
Photos from the scene and the tow yard show damage concentrated on the driver side front and door, which is in line
with the impact described.
April 9, 2025
Two independent witnesses gave statements that agree on the signal phase and the direction each vehicle was
travelling.
April 28, 2025
Requested the claimant's medical records. The concussion diagnosis fits the kind and force of a side impact of this
type, and the treating notes describe symptoms consistent with that diagnosis.
May 8, 2025
Checked the claimant's history and found no prior injury to the head or neck area on file. No earlier damage to the
vehicle appears in our records or the photos taken at the scene.
May 12, 2025
Treatment followed a typical course, with regular follow-up visits that became less frequent as symptoms eased. The
claimant reports steady improvement and has told the same account in every conversation so far.
June 2, 2025
Confirmed the policy was in force on the date of loss, the driver is named on the policy, and nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
June 28, 2025
Reviewed the repair estimate. Most of the listed damage matches the described impact, and the remaining items are
benig checked against the photos.
July 25, 2025
File is in order for settlement review. No further questions for the claimant at this time, and the claim will move to the
next stage once the final repair figures are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
